meta.title: Berlin parliamentary data · source verification
meta.scope: Public official web documentation only; not a downloaded parliamentary-record dataset
meta.source_mode: human-curated summaries of verified official pages
meta.attribution: Parlamentsdokumentation, Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin · dl-de/by-2-0 (https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/by-2-0). Descriptions in this project are modified/reworded summaries, not official statements.

sources.title: Open Data overview
sources.description: The house advertises PARDOK parliamentary-document metadata back to 1989, as XML, and describes daily updates and a beta API.
sources.limit: This landing page is not itself a download of parliamentary documents; availability is a publisher statement.

sources.title: PARDOK Open Data and API
sources.description: The publisher describes a read-only API for procedural records, activities, metadata and linked parliamentary documents, requiring an API key.
sources.limit: Documentation alone does not establish present uptime, response completeness or correctness. The example fetch in this project is not executed.

sources.title: PARDOK REST API OpenAPI specification
sources.description: The published OpenAPI contract includes a GET /vorgang endpoint with cursor pagination, page-size cap 200 and title/date/legislature filtering.
sources.limit: A contract is not proof that every documented response has been successfully retrieved.

sources.title: Open Data usage terms
sources.description: The terms specify Germany's Attribution 2.0 data licence, attribution/link/change-notice rules, and additional limits concerning alteration of official PDFs.
sources.limit: Rights of third parties and use of official documents need separate consideration.

sources.title: Federal parliament Open Data overview
sources.description: The Bundestag offers machine-readable plenary proceedings, parliamentary printed papers, MP biographies and roll-call vote lists in multiple formats.
sources.limit: Bundestag and Berlin PARDOK are different institutions and datasets; they do not independently validate each other's records.

sources.title: Dataset catalogue — Abgeordnetenhaus tag
sources.description: The Berlin data catalogue lists parliamentary-election and constituency geography datasets with formats and licensing labels.
sources.limit: Search-tag presence is not proof of the data's contents, latest status or publisher independence.

claims.title: Berlin parliamentary metadata reaches back to 1989
claims.finding: The parliament's own site describes the PARDOK metadata coverage as beginning with the 11th legislative period in 1989.
claims.boundary: No historical completeness audit has been performed.
claims.next: Acquire a small date-bounded export, log record count and compare document identifiers against the official search interface.

claims.title: A read-only Berlin parliamentary API is documented
claims.finding: The primary publisher publishes API documentation and a machine-readable endpoint specification. These sources describe the same underlying PARDOK service.
claims.boundary: Three URLs do not constitute three independent datasets or successful API calls.
claims.next: Run a bounded authenticated GET /vorgang, hash the response, validate pagination and review licence obligations.

claims.title: PARDOK data can be reused with attribution
claims.finding: The publisher's usage terms describe the dl-de/by-2-0 licence and state attribution and modification-notice requirements.
claims.boundary: Official PDFs and third-party rights carry additional caveats. This interface is an independent summary, not a reproduction of an official parliamentary document.
claims.next: Check the record-specific rights, show provider name, licence URL, dataset URI and modification marker on public outputs.

claims.title: Berlin and federal parliaments are separate evidence origins
claims.finding: The Berlin Abgeordnetenhaus and Deutscher Bundestag publish different documentary collections.
claims.boundary: Institutional difference does not mean observations within each dataset are independent confirmations of any claim.
claims.next: Preserve publisher ID, jurisdiction, document type, document ID, legislative period and upstream source URI.

claims.title: A real-time public-discourse network is already measured
claims.finding: Not established by this source review. Only documentation pages were checked; no social posts, speech corpus or PARDOK records were collected here.
claims.boundary: The adjacent 42% investigation is entirely fictional. No AI extraction, coordination detection or political risk score has run on real people.
claims.next: After rights and safety review, acquire a small public document set; establish a source-to-document-to-statement graph and independent evaluation.
